description: State Senate Candidate and Current Assemblyman Dan Stec endorses Matt Simpson for the 114th Assembly District Assemblyman Dan Stec has been a strong representative for our district and a champion of North Country values. It is an honor and truly humbling to receive his support. I know first hand the strength of his leadership and thorough approach to understanding the task at hand through my collaboration with him as President of Adirondack Association of Towns & Villages. I look forward to having the opportunity at proving to be just as strong and worthy a representative to the North Country as Dan Stec. View Video of Dan’s endorsement
title: Dan Stec endorses Matt Simpson -
